title: Granite Ridge Season Pass Schedule: Re-registration and Replacement Media Fees
content:
Three figures are published per tier of the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme for the pass media and the person it is registered to: whether the pass may be re-registered to a different named passholder, the fee placed on the pass account when it is, and the fee placed on the pass account when replacement pass media is issued.

| Tier | Re-registration allowed | Transfer fee (USD) | Replacement media fee (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | no | 55.00 | 35.00 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | no | 55.00 | 35.00 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | no | 55.00 | 30.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | yes | 75.00 | 30.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | yes | 75.00 | 25.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | yes | 95.00 | 0.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The three lowest tiers carry a published transfer fee although re-registration is not allowed on them; the figure is part of the tariff for every tier and is not itself a permission.

The replacement media fee falls as the tier rises, from 35.00 on the two lowest tiers to 0.00 on the Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass and the Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass.
